=============================================
  Extended CSD rev 1.8 (MMC 5.1)
=============================================

Card Supported Command sets [S_CMD_SET: 0x01]
HPI Features [HPI_FEATURE: 0x01]: implementation based on CMD13
Background operations support [BKOPS_SUPPORT: 0x01]
Max packed read cmd [MAX_PACKED_READS: 0x3f]
Max packed write cmd [MAX_PACKED_WRITES: 0x3f]
Data TAG support [DATA_TAG_SUPPORT: 0x01]
SEC Feature support [SEC_FEATURE_SUPPORT: 0x55]
  Secure Removal Type supported
  Sanitize supported
  Secure Purge supported
Trim Multiplier [TRIM_MULT: 0x08]
Secure Trim Multiplier [SEC_TRIM_MULT: 0x08]
